description: This file is a C++ source file implementing a plugin for the WPEFramework, specifically a Rust adapter plugin that loads Rust dynamic libraries, manages plugin contexts, and handles communication between C++ and Rust code.

classes.name: RequestContext
classes.description: Holds context information for a request, including channel ID and authentication token.

classes.name: PluginContext
classes.description: Represents a plugin context with an ID and a callback function to send data.

methods.name: wpe_send_to
methods.description: Extern C function called from Rust to send data to a specific plugin context based on context ID.

methods.name: get_library_search_paths
methods.description: Retrieves library search paths from the LD_LIBRARY_PATH environment variable.

methods.name: to_string
methods.description: Converts a JSONRPC message to its string representation.

methods.name: file_exists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the given path.

methods.name: find_rust_plugin
methods.description: Attempts to locate and load a Rust plugin shared library from specified paths.
